sections.h2: Dialysis coverage reaches 71% while oxygen concentrators stay at 9%

chart.title: Renal care is covered; oxygen and respiratory supply is not
chart.sub: Coverage, % as stated in the post's segment table.
chart.source: DoP approved-applicant list; PIB 16 Dec 2025; FY2025-26 TradeStat fetch.

sections.means: The post reports 71% dialysis coverage against 9% for oxygen concentrators, even though four concentrator makers hold PLI approval.
sections.todo: Treat oxygen supply as a procurement and demand-side problem before adding more concentrator applicants.

sections.h2: Lab instruments and pacemakers sit at 1-10% coverage with no PLI maker

chart.title: Import families with no PLI maker run at 1-10% coverage
chart.source: FY2025-26 (provisional) TradeStat fetch as cited in the post.

sections.means: Lab and analytical instruments, the largest unaddressed import family at $2.19bn, have 10% coverage and no PLI presence.
sections.todo: Target lab and analytical instruments first in any future SMDI, PRIP or PLI 2.0 round, since every CDSCO and pharma QC lab is captive demand.

sections.h2: Endoscopes reach 57% coverage with only a niche PLI applicant

chart.title: Endoscopes run at 57% coverage; ophthalmic instruments at 18%
chart.sub: Coverage, % as stated in the post's unaddressed-families list.
chart.source: FY2025-26 (provisional) TradeStat fetch as cited in the post.

sections.means: The post reports endoscopes at 57% coverage, well above ophthalmic instruments at 18%, although only a urology-niche Cat-B applicant covers the space.
sections.todo: Put endoscopes, with Japan-dominated imports, on the candidate list for the SMDI, PRIP and device-park pipeline.
